# Step 7(a) execution evidence

This proposed final selection preserves the seven-owner source correction, native candidate generation, one-row CAS promotion, receipt 22 and retained WITHHOLD followup. Durable main 61ff4ed4789e61ef64f6f75a792adf3b934e7c82 supplies unchanged input blobs and the 21-receipt prefix. C1 and C2 are real execution checkpoints. Changed source bytes are archived under their original identities; historical versions are never rebound to current bytes.

The CAS correction remains partial: known exact LIPID MAPS evidence, final primary-identifier/source eligibility and mapping approval remain open. Six stale node removals settle no identity, role or recipe questions. All six scoped mapping rows remain WITHHOLD. Existing melezitose and sodium FORM authority is preserved, without new scientific approval. The unified snapshot, provenance and rejection ledger stay fixed; broader issues 753, 870 and 902 remain open.

The current canonical has 2983 rows. Mapping review retains 1744 SUPPORTED and 1239 WITHHOLD. The full semantic release verdict remains FAIL, with 1733 blocking findings and 2333 blocking assertions. Successful integrity, generation, subset-export and package checks do not approve the whole graph. The three #902 reason qualifications retain historical concerns and holds; #1090 exporter changes correct partition dates.

The final native diagnostic pair was published through the repaired #1092 caller and independently read back against 3172 inputs and 42 exact raw captures. Its self_review:true and scientific_review:false scope is unchanged. The actual-KG B4 supplement records five present node tables and absent BTO/MICRO tables; external source tables are qualified prerequisites, not copied corpora or evidence of absent ontology terms. The empty-reject-report preservation distinguishes archived fresh QC output from the exact historical tracked headers.

Full just qc passed. The completed final MIM just test passed 4523 tests, skipped one and reported 33 warnings; maintained-package coverage was 76%. The single existing live-corpus test skips because every subject has an exactMatch, as a separate native probe confirms. The original failed suite remains preserved: 20 fixture-phase failures plus one real resolver failure. Issue #1093 repaired only the test fixture, with independent clearance. The after-suite check found all 3287 reviewed native-chain input hashes unchanged. All 25 changed maintained Python files had mtimes before the final test start; these observations supplement exact hashes and are not cryptographic attestation of continuous runtime stability.

Claw #712 merged as 33be66ab1b993e2a47792c13daa3e4f39635f2cb. Independent closure readback verifies its entire 1299-entry tree equals reviewed head c12e5285, five PR checks and five actual merge-group checks succeeded, and the owned remote/local branches were deleted. Both GitHub pytest runs passed 6683 tests with 391 skips and 87.18% coverage. Merge-integrity success is separately recorded. The local Claw full-suite failure is preserved: 13 sandbox /bin/ps failures, 6671 passes and 390 skips; the separate 56-test affected-module pass does not rewrite that failed execution.

The merged native-loader replay rechecked 2958 inputs across 2955 owners, restoring the existing herring merge resolution without changing fixed unified artifacts or clearing source-ID publication debt. Original source generation remains attributed to the unchanged Claw 9bd producer. Author source labels claw/ and mim/ retain an explicit logical-to-physical mapping. All mutation and setup failures remain with their actual limitations. Issue #882 stays open until this MIM recurrence repair merges; its original acceptance was delivered by #1026, and the later closure condition is the documented recurrence rather than unspecified wider work.

All prior selections' payload entries, qualified omissions and historical findings remain intact. The finite graph audit adds 128 exact original identities as durable Git references, two current archive identities and five external B4 prerequisites. Final code identities include the two tests required by the after-suite source map. The 103-path current_scope is an integrity inventory, not a promise to duplicate every generated flat/index output as archive payload. External ontology, KG, CultureMech and runtime prerequisites remain hash-bound; complete offline replay without those inputs is not claimed. Raw bytes, including CRLF, remain unchanged.

The abandoned transient CAS writer 02e85b4a has not been recovered from the inspected explicit archives/checkpoints and ignored-inclusive basename search. A differently named or compressed copy was not ruled out. Its design receipt is preserved as a qualified historical omission; current writer bytes do not substitute for it or use it as final clearance. Earlier nonstandard local command receipts remain exact artifacts and are not rewritten to resemble native receipts.

This selection contains completed execution evidence. Its independent approval, guarded publication/readback, final committed MIM head review, required remote MIM checks and verified merge/cleanup are subsequent external gates. They are not asserted complete here. The final selection review stays outside its own archive to avoid recursive growth. No maintained tree change, freeze or publication is performed by this builder. supervisor_binding is null and scientific_approval_added is false.
